_note: The bought guns (Sci-Fi Battle Weapons by Tirgames; Phase 21, docs/PHASE_21_OVERNIGHT_PLAN.md): which model each SpeedKills gun wears when the paid files are here (npm run paid makes them, locally), and its procedural model otherwise. The legacy game never wears them. model is a file under models, always a _2 build: the pack's _1 of each family is the same gun (the same length, muzzle and sights, measured) in one piece, with no magazine, slide or pump a reload or a shot can move, so three guns that wore a _1 (rspn101, 3030, g2) kept their magazines in on a reload until pictures of each gun's builds showed it. skins is the order the gun's three skins come in as its fusion level rises (as found, levels 2 to 3, levels 4 to 5): a gun sharing a family with another starts from a different one, so the pair differs at a glance. Every model's measurements (its length, muzzle, sight top and the seat a fitted optic sits on) are in src/config/paidmodels.json, which tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts writes off the models and fails when they part. One model a gun, by its class (the owner): the rifles and PULSAR (a fast marksman; the pack has no marksman rifle, and the scoped rifle is the nearest) wear SciFiRifle01, the two SMGs and the two shotguns one each, HELIX and BOOG the sniper, NOVA the launcher (the pack's only drum-fed heavy); its two pistols and rocket launcher fit no gun here. Guns sharing a model start in different skins, so they differ at a glance.
_glow: How bright a bought gun's glow (its emission map) is at each fusion level, 0 to 5: a step a level, so a fused gun reads as better at a glance. Ours.
_sights: The pack's own sights, by part name, and what a fitted optic does to them (every SpeedKills gun wears one): hide, the scopes a model carries as parts of their own (the rifle's, the steady SMG's), which the optic takes the place of; fold, the launcher's flip-up sights, which fold flat as a real gun's backup sights do (standing, the front one stood in the optic's window). ownScope, the families whose scope is one piece with the gun (the sniper's): a fitted optic that draws its picture over the screen (optics.ts overlay) leaves its housing off and sights down the gun's own scope, where two scopes stood stacked. The seat an optic sits on, and the scope's axis, are measured without these parts (tools/checks/paid-weapons.ts, paidmodels.json railTop, scope).
_motion: How the pack's own moving parts move, since the pack gives its guns split into parts and no animations (paidgun.ts finds each part by name and hinges it at its measured edge; viewmodel.ts moves it). Radians, metres, seconds. trigger: how far it swings back on a shot, held that long and let go over release, so an automatic's stays in through a burst. drumRate: how quickly the launcher's drum turns to its next chamber (a chamber a shot, the angle between its rounds counted off the model), as a rate a second. spinnerTurns: the sniper's two side wheels, turns each over a rechamber (whole turns, so each comes to rest as it started); spinnerAim: turns more going into the sights, the zoom wound in. cover: how far the heavy shotgun's loading gate swings open, on a shell reload and with the pump. roundTravel: how far below its port the shell in the hand starts. buttonPress: how far a magazine release goes in at a reload's start. extruder: how far the rifle's extruder, under the receiver, drops on a shot. sightFold: how far a flip-up sight folds, forward. Ours.
_props: The rest of the pack where the game has the thing (W7): the model a prop wears when the paid files are here, and its skin. mine is the MINE hack's mine (ours was a lit ring); its size is the model's own. deathbox is a death box (ours was a dark crate with an orange glow). carepackage is a care package (ours was a lit cylinder), the 1.51 m weapon case drawn at scale, which reads from further off. healkit is the med kit standing in the middle of a HEAL area (ours was the lit ring alone), 0.40 by 0.38 m on its own base; healkitEnemy the same in another skin, for an enemy's area.
